faq.title: Good to know
faq.q1: How long does delivery take in Raipur?
faq.a1: Most orders arrive in 1–3 days. The product page shows the expected time and your order page shows each step.
faq.a2: Cash on delivery for now. UPI and card payments are coming soon.
faq.q3: What if the part does not fit?
faq.a3: Tell us within 7 days from your order page. After a quick check we replace it or refund you. Opened lubricants and installed batteries cannot be returned.
faq.a4: Our team calls or visits every workshop, checks its location and services, and watches its reviews.
faq.q5: Will a workshop start work without asking me?
faq.a5: No. You approve the itemised estimate line by line before any work starts.
faq.q6: Can I order in bulk for my garage or fleet?
faq.a6: Yes. Ask for a bulk price from any product page or your cart and agree the final price with our team in a chat.

returns.title: Returns, refunds and faulty parts
returns.lead: Please check that a part fits your vehicle before you order. Not sure? Ask us first. We're happy to help.
returns.noReturnsBody: Products can't be returned or exchanged if you change your mind, order the wrong part or no longer need it.
returns.faultyBody: If a part is faulty, arrives damaged or isn't what you ordered, contact support within {days} days of delivery with photos. Our team checks it with the shop, then replaces the part or refunds you.
returns.unfulfilledBody: If we can't confirm your order with a shop, or you cancel before it is packed, you pay nothing for cash-on-delivery orders and online payments are refunded in full once our team approves it.
returns.refundsBody: Refunds go back to the way you paid; for cash-on-delivery orders, to your bank account or UPI ID. We start the refund within 2 working days of approval; banks usually take 5 to 7 working days.
returns.coinsBody: Coins used on a cancelled order are given back as coins. Coins have no cash value and are never paid out as money.
returns.help: Questions about an order? Call us:

privacy.title: Privacy
privacy.lead: What we keep about you, why, who sees it, and how you stay in control. Plain words, no surprises.
privacy.whoBody: MechDost is run by {company}, {address}. We decide how your data is used and we answer for it.
privacy.collectBody: Your name, mobile number and email; a password, stored only as a scrambled code we cannot read back; delivery addresses; your vehicles and service history; your orders, bookings and support messages.
privacy.purposeBody: To deliver your orders and run your workshop bookings, to answer your support requests, to keep accounts safe from misuse, and to keep the order and tax records the law asks for. Nothing else without asking you first.
privacy.shareBody: Only the shop or workshop handling your order or booking, and only after they accept it — your number and address stay hidden until then. Order updates on WhatsApp go through Meta when you have them switched on. We never sell your data.
privacy.analyticsTitle: Analytics, only if you allow it
privacy.analyticsBody: With “Allow analytics” we count page visits and clicks to improve MechDost. Our servers pass these counts to our analytics provider PostHog, on its servers in the European Union, under a random visitor number. They never hold your name, number or address, phone numbers or emails typed into search are removed first, and nothing goes to PostHog without your permission. Choose “Essential only” any time with “Privacy choices” at the bottom of every page.
privacy.errorsBody: When a page or our servers fail, a short technical report goes to Sentry, our error-tracking provider, on its servers in the European Union, so we can fix the fault. Reports hold the page address and what went wrong, never your name, number, address or anything you typed; we need them to keep the site working, so they are sent without asking.
privacy.safeBody: Encrypted connections everywhere, sensitive details encrypted again in our database, staff access only for the part of their job, and a log of every change staff make.
privacy.rightsBody: Ask us to show, correct or delete your data, or withdraw a permission you gave. Deletion is confirmed by our support team first; order and invoice records are kept as long as tax law requires, then removed.
privacy.help: Questions, requests or complaints about your data? Call us:

delivery.title: Delivery and payment
delivery.lead: How your order reaches you, what you pay and when.
delivery.pinBody: Enter your PIN code to see which parts we can deliver to you, the price from the nearest shop, the delivery charge and how many days delivery takes.
delivery.pricesBody: Part prices include GST. The delivery charge is shown separately before you order, and delivery is free above the amount shown at checkout.
delivery.confirmTitle: A nearby shop confirms your order
delivery.confirmBody: We send your order to a verified shop near you. Once the shop accepts it, we tell you it is confirmed and on its way. If no shop can take it, we let you know and you pay nothing.
delivery.codeBody: When your order is out for delivery you get a 4-digit delivery code. Give it to the delivery person only when the parts are in your hands.
delivery.payBody: Pay cash on delivery for orders up to the limit shown at checkout. Online payment is coming soon; until then nothing is charged before delivery.
delivery.cancelBody: You can cancel until the shop packs your order. After that, parts can't be returned unless they are faulty, damaged or wrong; see our returns policy.
delivery.help: Questions about a delivery? Call us:

service.title: Workshop bookings
service.lead: How a booking works, and why no work starts without your approval.
service.findBody: Tell us where your vehicle is. We show verified workshops nearby; pick one, or let MechDost choose for you.
service.proposalTitle: The workshop proposes a time and cost
service.proposalBody: The workshop suggests a date, a time slot and an expected cost range. Your booking is confirmed only when you accept it.
service.estimateTitle: You approve every line of work
service.estimateBody: After checking your vehicle, the workshop sends an itemised estimate. You approve or decline each line. Work you have not approved is not done and not charged.
service.cancelBody: You can cancel a booking free of charge until the workshop has your vehicle.
service.billBody: When the work is done you get a final bill with only the work you approved, and you pay that bill.
service.pickupBody: Vehicle pickup is available only where a workshop offers it, and is agreed with the workshop for your booking. We don't offer roadside help yet.
service.help: Questions about a booking? Call us:

terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.lead: The rules for using MechDost to buy vehicle parts and book workshop services in Raipur. Plain words; by using MechDost you agree to them.
terms.whoBody: MechDost is a marketplace run by {company}, {address}. We connect you with independent local shops that sell vehicle parts and with verified workshops that service vehicles. The shop or workshop is the seller of the product or the provider of the service; MechDost arranges the order, the routing, payment and support.
terms.accountBody: You sign up with your mobile number (confirmed by a one-time code) and then sign in with your phone or email and a password. Keep your password to yourself and tell us at once if someone else may have used your account. Give true details: a wrong address or number can make an order fail. We may pause or close an account that is misused — for example fake cash-on-delivery orders, abuse of staff or partners, or fraud.
terms.ordersBody: Prices include GST and are shown for your PIN code; the delivery charge is shown before you order. An order is a request until a nearby shop confirms it: MechDost offers it to a shop, and if no shop can supply it we cancel it and refund anything you paid in full. When the order is out for delivery you get a delivery code: give it to the delivery person only after you have the parcel. Cash on delivery has an upper limit and may be unavailable for some orders or accounts.
terms.paymentsBody: Pay online through our payment partner (Razorpay) or in cash on delivery where offered. MechDost never asks for your card or UPI PIN. Refunds always go back to the way you paid, usually within 5–7 working days after we start them. An order that cannot be fulfilled is refunded in full.
terms.returnsTitle: No returns or exchanges — help when something is wrong
terms.returnsBody: We do not take returns or exchanges for a change of mind. If a part arrives faulty, damaged or wrong, raise a support request from your order within the time shown there, with photos; we check it and replace the part or refund you. Manufacturer warranties stay with the manufacturer, and we help you use them. Read the returns policy for details.
terms.servicesBody: For a service you ask a workshop for a time; the workshop proposes a slot and an expected cost, and you accept it. After it receives your vehicle it sends an itemised estimate: only the lines you approve are done and billed, and new work needs your new approval. You pay the workshop for the work it did; the workshop is responsible for the quality of its work, and we help if there is a problem. Read the workshop booking terms for details.
terms.coinsBody: Coins are a discount on later orders when the offer says so. They have no cash value, cannot be withdrawn, transferred or exchanged for money, and expire as shown in your account. Refunds never become Coins.
terms.messagesBody: We send updates about your orders, bookings and support requests by SMS, email, WhatsApp and in the app — they are part of the service. Offers and promotions are sent only if you agreed to them, and you can stop them at any time (for WhatsApp, reply STOP). Standard message charges of your mobile operator may apply.
terms.useBody: Do not misuse MechDost: no false orders or bookings, fake reviews, attempts to get around payment or security checks, copying the site with automated tools, or anything unlawful. Reviews must be about your own experience. We may remove content and limit accounts that break these rules.
terms.partnersBody: Shops and workshops that sell on MechDost also agree to the MechDost seller or workshop agreement, accepted in their portal. They are independent businesses; MechDost checks them before listing them but does not employ them.
terms.liabilityBody: We take care to show correct product details, prices and availability, and we fix mistakes when we find them. As far as the law allows, MechDost is not responsible for losses we could not reasonably foresee, or for how a part is fitted by someone else. Nothing in these terms takes away your rights under the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.
terms.privacyBody: How we collect and use your data, and your choices, are explained in our privacy policy.
terms.changesBody: We may update these terms; the date below shows the latest version, and important changes are announced on the site before they apply. These terms follow Indian law, and the courts at Raipur, Chhattisgarh decide any dispute.
terms.contactBody: Raise a support request from your account, or call or WhatsApp us. Our grievance officer acknowledges a complaint within 48 hours and resolves it within one month, as the Consumer Protection (E-Commerce) Rules require.
